title: Web-Proof Trust
description: The zkTLS trust boundary, explorable: switch between Plain TLS, MPC-TLS, Proxy-TLS and TEE-TLS to see where the session key lives and whom you must trust, then hit "forge the value" — plain TLS accepts the lie, the other three catch it at different costs.
controls: tap a tab (or ←/→) to switch channel design
tap "forge the value" to attempt a forgery
